item.title: EUR/GBP holds gains above 0.8700 ahead of Eurozone HICP inflation data
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross holds positive ground around 0.8725 during the early European session on Tuesday. The Pound Sterling (GBP) softens against the Euro (EUR) amid political uncertainty in the UK and growing expectations of the Bank of England (BoE) rate cut.

item.title: Gold sticks to gains above $5,350 amid sustained safe-haven demand; firmer USD caps gains
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to its positive bias for the third straight day and trades above the $5,350 level heading into the European session on Tuesday.

item.title: USD/CHF holds gains above 0.7800 as US Dollar gains on risk aversion
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground for the second successive session, trading around 0.7810 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair advances as the US Dollar (USD) strengthens on heightened safe-haven demand amid the Middle East war.

item.title: ECB’s Lane: Prolonged conflict could lead to a substantial spike in inflation
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) chief economist Philip Lane said on Tuesday that a prolonged conflict could lead to a substantial spike in inflation. At the same time, it could also cause a sharp drop in output in the euro area.

item.title: US forces destroy command facilities of Iran’s IRGC
item.description: US military officials said on Tuesday that they have destroyed command posts of Iran’s Revolutionary Guards as well as Iranian air defense and missile launch sites since the start of the joint Israeli-US offensive on Saturday.

item.title: WTI surges to near $73 as Strait of Hormuz closure prompts supply shocks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trades 2.3% higher to near $73.00 during the early European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Brent: Conflict-driven spike and eurozone risks – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analysts Charlie Lay and Moses Lim note Brent crude has surged toward USD79–80 as shipping through the Strait of Hormuz is effectively halted, disrupting Oil and LNG flows.

item.title: Asian stocks fall on Iran war risks, South Korea’s Kospi leads losses
item.description: Asian equities trade mostly lower on Tuesday as traders remain concerned about the rising tensions in the Middle East. South Korean stocks, the benchmark Kospi, sank as much as 6.9%, the most since August 2024, amid risk-off sentiment. The Nikkei 225, Japan’s benchmark, fell 3.15% to 56,222.

item.title: USD: Safe-haven flows return with war risks – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank strategist Molly Schwartz highlights that the US Dollar’s strong performance reflects renewed safe-haven demand as geopolitical risks escalate around Iran.

item.title: Pound Sterling continues to underperform amid US-Israel war with Iran
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) trades lower against its major currency peers, slides 0.3% to near 1.3360 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.
